coding.why: small, specified functions with hidden tests; requires the hermetic sandbox (results without it are INCOMPLETE, never guessed)

cost.why: derived from measured GPU time x the persisted rate; report-only

counterfactual_reasoning.why: exact set/number answers computed from dependency graphs and formula systems; chance near 0.05; hard for small models so the floor is modest

cross_domain_transfer.why: capability not claimed today; n=60 is LOW_POWER; reserved so the roadmap cannot silently omit it

discovery_quality.why: anchor-matched discoveries; n=60 is LOW_POWER; V1 reports precision/recall/decoy rate only

evidence_use.why: strategic; correct answer AND exact supporting evidence ids or a correct abstention; chance is near 0.05

hypothesis_testing.why: choose a discriminating experiment or a verdict; chance about 0.25-0.33, so 0.50 is comfortably above guessing

information_gain_reasoning.why: pick the single question with maximal information gain (ties accepted) or recognise sufficiency; chance about 0.2-0.25

instruction_following.why: every item needs 2-4 jointly satisfiable verifiable constraints ALL met (chance is near 0); a competent instruction-tuned model commonly meets multi-constraint prompts on roughly half to most items, so 0.45 rejects models that cannot follow explicit format rules without rejecting borderline ones

latency.why: measured by the harness under recorded hardware; report-only

long_context.why: gated on the 8k slice only (n=100); 16k and 40k are LOW_POWER report-only slices because vendor-supported context differs across models

mathematics.why: exact numeric answers (chance near 0); short multi-step arithmetic/number-theory items, so 0.45 separates models that compute from those that pattern-match

multilingual.why: overall over English/Hindi/Tamil/Kannada (50 each); per-language results are LOW_POWER report-only; the floor is lower than monolingual floors because low-resource-script items are harder for small models

multimodal_where_applicable.why: N/A for text-only models (not a fail); n=60 is LOW_POWER

reasoning.why: unique-answer logic puzzles with answer spaces of 3-6 (chance about 0.2); 0.35 requires clearly better than guessing while accepting small models

research.why: multi-hop answer AND exact citation set must both be right (chance near 0); 0.45 accepts models that ground answers in supplied documents

strict_contracts.why: raw-model contract behaviour is a recovery-cost signal only; SYSTEM_CONTRACT_QUALIFICATION belongs to ORNEUR itself

structured_outputs.why: extraction from an explicit passage into a stated schema is the easiest gated skill; the Contract Engine can retry once, so the floor is set below the earlier 0.85 no-repair proposal but well above chance (which is near 0 for exact field values)

tool_use.why: tool name plus exact arguments, including refusal when no tool applies or an argument is missing; explicit specs make this comparatively easy

trainability.why: Stage-3 finalists only: common pilot on PILOT_TRAIN, then re-run of format categories and a regression check; a measurement, never an entry floor

verification.why: strategic; planted-error step identification and claim-vs-evidence labels have chance about 0.2-0.33, so 0.50 requires real checking ability

confidence_interval_method.name: wilson_score_95
confidence_interval_method.note: nominal Wilson intervals; template clustering is reported, not used in decisions (see uncertainties)

design_level_readiness_historical.meaning: the funnel DESIGN was structurally ready (Eternal Architecture 1.1 pre-freeze check). It is not the freeze of the actual eval.

coding.low_power_handling: n < 100: may only FAIL a model, and only when the 95% upper bound < floor; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_POWER (never a pass, never a ranking signal)

floors_supersede_design_proposals.reason: the design-time proposals were unreviewed round numbers; the frozen floors are set from item difficulty, chance baselines and the power arithmetic recorded per category. Every frozen floor is at least 0.10 above the category's chance baseline.

immutability: any substantive change to any hashed input (corpus, floors, rules, harness, scorers) requires Eval V2

languages.authoring_note: language-appropriate items authored per language (not word-for-word translations); native-speaker review has NOT been performed

no_model_qualifies_rule: if no finalist clears every frozen floor the result is NO_MODEL_QUALIFIES: nothing is selected, floors are never lowered after the fact (that requires Eval V2), and the owner decides the next step
remaining_uncertainties: items are template instances; correlated within template, so nominal intervals overstate power (cluster sizes in the manifest)
floors are reasoned from chance baselines and task design, not from any model result; they may reject every model or none
Hindi/Tamil/Kannada items were authored by an AI assistant and have not been reviewed by native speakers
the coding category cannot be scored until an attested hermetic sandbox exists; until then Stage 2 cannot complete
semantic-overlap checking is a protocol hook only; no embedding model is configured
long-context lengths are approximate (fixed words-per-token ratio); tokenizer-specific lengths differ
the Stage-1 GPU-time cap of 0.25 h per model is a planning assumption, unmeasured
discovery scoring uses evidence anchors plus keyword diagnostics, which is brittle for paraphrased falsifiers and actions

sandbox_requirements.captured_streams: stdout and stderr captured separately, truncated at max_output_bytes, stored in the evidence record
sandbox_requirements.determinism: fixed hash seed, fixed locale and timezone, no clock or randomness access beyond what tests supply
sandbox_requirements.filesystem: read-only root; single ephemeral writable tmpfs; no host mounts; no access to the corpus, the repository, credentials or environment secrets
sandbox_requirements.isolation: one fresh container/VM per candidate response; no state shared between candidates; killed and destroyed after scoring
sandbox_requirements.network: DISABLED (no interfaces except loopback; DNS and egress blocked)
sandbox_requirements.process_limits: no fork bombs (process cap), no privilege escalation (non-root, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, seccomp allow-list)
test_result_evidence: the exact code digest that ran
sandbox_requirements.timeout: hard wall-clock kill per test and per response; a timeout scores the test as failed and is recorded

scoring.code_items: PENDING_SANDBOX in this phase: never executed; coding is INCOMPLETE until an attested hermetic sandbox scores it
scoring.discovery_scoring: anchor-matching against ground-truth evidence anchors and decoys; keyword checks for falsifier/action are diagnostics only

selection_rule: No model is selected in this phase. A future selection must use per-capability results from the frozen Genesis Capability Eval V1 and this pre-registered rule, applied only after every finalist has completed the same trainability pilot: (1) a model must clear every frozen floor on the gating categories; (2) among survivors, drop any model Pareto-dominated on every gating category at equal or lower cost; (3) rank the remainder lexicographically by verification, then evidence_use, then trainability, then cost; (4) ties or irreconcilable trade-offs go to an explicit owner decision. strict_contracts is a report-only recovery-cost signal and is never a floor or a ranking input. Release date, parameter count and popularity are never inputs.

splits.PILOT_TRAIN: pilot-training examples for the Stage-3 trainability pilot only

stage1.drop_rule: drop only if the 95% upper bound of a gating slice with n >= 30 is below its frozen floor; report-only and LOW_POWER slices never drop a model
stage1.name: small common screening probe

probe.selection: first 30 holdout items of each gating category in ascending item-sha256 order

stage2.incomplete_results: a candidate missing, NaN, infinite, boolean or out-of-range on any mandatory gating category is INCOMPLETE and cannot enter Stage 3 (IncompleteStage2Results)
stage2.name: full capability eval
stage2.over_cap_order: family representatives (cheapest per family, ties by model id) ordered by projected cost then model id, admitted while the cap permits; then remaining survivors by ascending cost then id
stage2.over_cap_rule: cheapest survivor per architecture family, then ascending projected cost then id (explicit resource gate)

stage3.entry_order: Pareto-non-dominated on capability and cost, then one per architecture family, then ascending cost, then id
stage3.name: trainability pilot
stage3.who: up to 3 finalists chosen from PRE-TRAINABILITY criteria only

strict_contracts_role: report-only recovery-cost signal; never a floor and never a ranking input
tie_rule: if two or more finalists are identical on verification, evidence_use, trainability and cost, the result is OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED_TIE; no automatic tie-break by name, size, date or popularity
